Hi Tessa,

Hope all's well. We're approaching our contract renewal window with Redwood (contract ends 2028-09-30) and expect to increase monthly committed capacity by ~40% for the next 12 months to support a new analytics product launch. Procurement asked we start the renewal/AMR conversation early so we can align budgets.

Can we schedule a kickoff/QBR to:
- walk through current usage (attached May export)
- align on uplift sizing and term options (12 vs 24 months)
- surface procurement timeline and required documents

Attaching a small usage summary from our side (Helion_usage_May-2028.pdf). Raj will join on the technical sizing piece; procurement will need a high-level mutual action plan.

Preferred window: week of Jul 3 — afternoons PT. If you have a short checklist or kickoff agenda you typically use, please share.

Thanks,
Claire Johnson
Head of Platform
Helion Analytics

Thanks Claire — appreciate the early heads-up and the usage file.

Quick plan from our side:
1) Kickoff/QBR (30–45m): review usage, uplift sizing, and goals. We'll bring capacity recommendations and term/price options.
2) Mutual Action Plan (MAP): Redwood will draft a one-pager listing milestones, procurement artifacts, and lead owners.
3) Procurement checklist & redlines: share contract amendment template and a proposed pricing table for 12/24 mo terms.

Can you confirm who from Helion will be the final contract approver and whether SSO audits or additional compliance evidence will be required?

I've opened a quick Doodle-style poll for Jul 3–6 afternoons PT: https://calendar.google.com/poll?cid=helion-qbr-poll — please mark preferred slots.

For visibility, looping in Marissa (Customer Success lead) for post-renewal onboarding, Karthik (solutions/throughput for sizing), and Vanessa (legal handoff for amendments).

Attachments we will share before the call:
- Redwood uplift sizing recommendation (slide)
- draft amendment (pdf)
- MAP template (Drive link)

Next steps: if you confirm procurement timing (target sign ~Aug 20), we'll aim to have a draft amendment and pricing to you within one week of the kickoff.

Best,

Thanks Tessa — we've all voted on the poll. Best slots are Jul 5, 2–4pm PT or Jul 6, 3–4pm PT.

Answers to your questions:
- Final approver: Priya Menon (VP Finance). She typically signs once Procurement confirms pricing and legal OKs the amendment.
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 Type II report is required; we have an in-flight vendor questionnaire too.
- Procurement timeline: target sign ~Aug 18–22, budget booked by Aug 1 (internal constraint).

On sizing: Raj will bring spike metrics for the new product, but provisional uplift estimate is +35–45% committed capacity and 2x peak burst.

We'll plan to review the draft amendment on the call so our legal/procurement teams can flag points early.

Claire
